citations.question: The hidden file (failure-and-recovery.md) lists how each feature can fail and how to fix it. Some features build the hidden file, the plan's evals folder, or a check. When one of these features fails, may the fix that the builder gets name the thing that the feature builds?
citations.answer: Yes. When a feature builds the hidden file, the plan's evals folder or a check, the fix that the builder gets may name that thing. It is part of the product that the builder sees and changes. For example, fn-795 writes the hidden file, and fn-898 builds the lint check and the ledger check. The fix never names the eval, or the check that found the failure. Every other fix that the builder gets names none of them. A fix that cannot be said without them goes to 'a person must decide'.
